chunks: And in a narration of Abu Baseer from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

When you intend to enter the state of Ihram on the Day of Tarwiyah, do as you did when you intended to enter Ihram: trim your moustache, clip your nails, shave your pubic hair if you have any, pluck your armpits, perform Ghusl, and wear your Ihram garments. Then go to the Sacred Masjid and pray six Raka'at before entering Ihram, supplicate to Allah and ask Him for assistance, and say: 'O Allah, I intend the Hajj, so make it easy for me and release me from where You have detained me by Your decree which You have ordained upon me.'

And you should say: 'My hair, skin, flesh, and blood are prohibited for You, from women, perfume, and garments; I intend thereby Your Face and the Abode of the Hereafter. Release me from where You have detained me by Your decree which You have ordained upon me.'

Then recite the Talbiyah from the Sacred Masjid just as you recited it when you entered Ihram, and say: 'Here I am, O Allah, for a Hajj that is complete and delivered to You.' And if you are able for your journey to Mina to coincide with the decline of the sun, do so; otherwise, whenever it is easy for you from the Day of Tarwiyah.

key_terms.التَّرْوِيَةِ: Day of Tarwiyah, the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah
key_terms.تُحْرِمَ: To enter the state of Ihram (ritual consecration)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended rituals and supplications for entering Ihram on the Day of Tarwiyah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi prescribes the Sunnah of performing Ihram on the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah, emphasizing spiritual preparation through purification and six Raka'at of prayer in the Sacred Mosque. It highlights the Shia emphasis on conscious intention (Niyyah) and submission to Divine Decree (Qadr) through specific supplications before the Talbiyah, reflecting the ritual precision characteristic of Imami jurisprudence.
